name: Knife skin
definition: A finish that changes the look of an in-game knife, bayonet or other melee weapon.
notes: Split from I2.6.2.01: skin sites list Knives as their own browse category beside Rifle, Pistol, SMG

name: Sticker capsule
definition: A container that opens into one sticker, patch, graffiti or music kit, usually without a key.
notes: Split from I2.6.4.01: capsule database treats capsules as separate from weapon cases (most open without a key)

name: Sewing pattern file
definition: A downloadable PDF sewing pattern printed at home and cut to make a garment or item.
notes: Split from I2.5.2.01: sold under Sewing Pattern as a digital PDF format

name: Knitting or crochet pattern file
definition: A downloadable PDF knitting or crochet pattern.
notes: Split from I2.5.2.01: Ravelry stores sell downloadable PDF knitting patterns by garment category

name: Photo editing preset pack
definition: A set of saved photo-editing settings (Lightroom XMP or mobile DNG presets).
notes: Split from I2.5.4.02: shops sell Lightroom presets as their own product

name: LUT pack
definition: A set of colour look-up table files (CUBE, 3DL) for grading video and photos.
notes: Split from I2.5.4.02: sold as LUT packs (12 .CUBE and 12 .3DL files)
